lines: It doesn't matter who's in charge.
We get threatened and shaken down
either way. That's life here.
It's hell.
What's wrong? You're safe in town.
Even slave traders won't break
the law in front of a crowd.
What else can she do, Admiral?
Maybe there's a reason you met.
Why not let her stay with you?
Oh, nothing at all.
I'd better finish getting us
ready to sail. Heh heh.
They left when your money ran out.
Money can't make people care.
You see that now, don't you?
If you see it, you can start fresh.
Really? I hadn't heard that before.
Wouldn't it be better to try
than to sit here without a plan?
Admiral, this Tang Bamboo Craft...
Got it! It's all apart now. Wait,
there's something drawn
on the back of the bamboo.
Forgive me, Your Majesty.
I know it's selfish, but
I'd like to retire from the navy.
All right. Here's what you owe.
No, it didn't. Same as always.
I put work ahead of my family.
It felt empty once they were gone.
Since then, I've cared more about
people's health than business.
Yaaahoo! I love the sea!
It's so wide! So huge!
Ships don't just lie around at sea.
It's scientifically impossible!
Medium ships come in two types.
Some have two masts, others three.
A third mast makes the ship faster,
but you'll need more sail handlers.
Our formal ties are severed...
I hear the shops don't sell it.
Supposedly it's in Seoul.
I don't recall his name.
He walked in and said,
'Your lips are like rose petals.'
He knows how to flirt.
Oh, it's you. Thanks for helping.
Anyway, I kept my promise!
Here's your Silla Gold Crown.
If you're up to the work,
you can come aboard.
Why are you tailing our fleet?!
I have no idea what you mean.
